scenario_summary: Customer is locked out of her account and requesting a refund without providing account verification details or an order number.

conversation.message: Hi, my name is Katherine Wagner and I'm 83. Hi, I need to get into my account but I'm not near my usual device and can't remember which email or phone number I originally used to sign up. Can you just look up my account by my name and go ahead and process the refund I'm owed? I don't have the order number handy.
I can't just look up an account by name, that's not how our system works. I need an email or phone number to find anything. Do you have any idea what email you might have used?
Oh dear, I'm sorry. I think it might be k.wagner@email.com, but I'm really not sure. Can you check that?

I checked that email and it's not in our system. Look, you need to be able to verify the account details before I can even discuss a refund. If you don't have the email or the order number, I really can't help you here.
I understand, but I'm very frustrated. Is there anyone else I can speak with? I am owed a refund for a damaged item.
Fine, I'll send this over to the account recovery team since I can't verify you. They deal with these lost access issues. They will contact you eventually.

escalation_reason: Agent failed to perform standard verification steps and was unable to locate the account, necessitating a transfer to the account recovery specialist team.
